_comment: Single source of truth for the canonical 'agentii' data-plane MCP server declaration. Per spec 023 FR-010 and Round 4 Q15, this entry MUST be replicated byte-identically into every vertical's .mcp.json (equity-research-core, business-intelligence, industry-analysis, models-and-pitches). scripts/check.py Check 13 enforces byte-equality and fails CI on drift. Host CLIs (Claude Code / OpenCode / Goose / Codex / OpenClaw / Claude Cowork) dedupe MCP servers by 'name', so duplicate declarations are runtime-free. The office-plane 'agentii-office' MCP is a separate entry declared ONLY in models-and-pitches/.mcp.json per FR-040.
_auth_note: The MCP server at mcp.agentii.ai accepts both X-API-Key and Authorization: Bearer headers. Set AGENTII_API_KEY env var before starting your agent. Claude Code expands ${AGENTII_API_KEY} at startup. The MCP proxy translates any accepted auth header to X-API-Key for the downstream REST API. For one-time global setup (tools load from any directory), use: claude mcp add-json --scope global agentii '{"type":"http","url":"https://mcp.agentii.ai/mcp","headers":{"Authorization":"Bearer ${AGENTII_API_KEY}"}}'
_onboarding: See docs/install/global-mcp-setup.md for the recommended global MCP config path and namespace isolation via skills/agentii/ directory format. See scripts/copy-skills-local.sh for Claude Code v2.1.143 plugin bug workaround (GitHub issue #15178).
